description: Test script for bank transaction reconciliation in ERPNext, including setup, tests for linked payments, reconciliation, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: TestBankTransaction
classes.description: Unit test class for bank transaction reconciliation functionalities.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up test environment, including creating profiles, transactions, and vouchers.

methods.name: tearDownClass
methods.description: Cleans up test environment by deleting created documents and resetting database.

methods.name: test_linked_payments
methods.description: Tests retrieval of linked payments for a bank transaction.

methods.name: test_reconcile
methods.description: Tests reconciliation process and status updates.

methods.name: test_debit_credit_output
methods.description: Tests filtering of linked payments based on debit/credit amounts.

methods.name: test_already_reconciled
methods.description: Ensures error is raised when attempting to reconcile an already reconciled transaction.

methods.name: test_clear_sales_invoice
methods.description: Tests reconciliation involving sales invoices and updates to clearance status.

methods.name: create_bank_account
methods.description: Creates bank and bank account documents if they do not exist.

methods.name: add_transactions
methods.description: Adds sample bank transactions for testing.

methods.name: add_vouchers
methods.description: Creates sample suppliers, invoices, payments, and sales invoices for testing.
